title: Fun in the Kitchen
text: Fun in the Kitchen. I married a Star Wars geek. I gave birth to another one. These Pyrex containers were destined for my kitchen! We like the Star Wars pictures. The pieces are quality pieces and what I would expect from Pyrex. I needed a new 2 cup measuring cup so I am thrilled to have one with a lid! I would be interested in seeing what other Star Wars items they may have.

product_metadata.title: Pyrex 8-Pc Glass Food Storage Container Set with Measuring Cup, 2-Cup & 4-Cup Decorated Round Meal Prep Containers, 2-Cup Measuring Cup, Non-Toxic, BPA-Free Lids, Disney's Star Wars
features: KITCHEN ESSENTIALS: Set includes (1) 2-Cup measuring cup, (2) 2-Cup, (1) 4-Cup round glass containers with plastic lids that are perfect for cooking, mixing and more! Organizing doesn't have to be dull, you can now store your snacks with a smile.

USE THE FORCE: Jedi or Sith, one's gotta eat, and what better way to do it than with your favorite Star Wars characters. These decorative Star Wars glass containers are great for keeping ingredients fresh or taking lunch and snacks on the C-3P-go.
EVERYDAY USE: High-quality tempered glass gives you a peace of mind when storing your food, resists stains and odors. Worry less about scrubbing hard to get rid of stains or any funny smells.
NON-TOXIC LID: BPA-Free plastic lid is freezer, microwave, and top-rack dishwasher safe. No need to hold back when warming your food or storing your leftovers for tomorrow.
PERFECT LID FIT: Plastic lid fits snug over glass container to keep your food fresh and tasty. Bold lids in red and blue make for a bold accent of galactic proportions.
LIMITED WARRANTY: This item has a limited 2-year warranty.

A TRUSTED BRAND: Loved for generations, experienced cooks and beginners alike have reached for Pyrex brand glassware products, because they’re affordable, durable, and great for all their cooking, serving and storing needs.
description: Store, serve or take food on the go with this Star Wars™ x Pyrex® storage set, featuring Yoda™, R2-D2™, and Darth Vader™. Durable, pure Pyrex® glass is microwave, dishwasher and freezer safe, and because it’s stain and odor-resistant, it preserves your food’s flavor. The clear marks on the measuring cup give you at-a-glance precision, and the handle and spout are designed for controlled pouring. Set Includes:  (2) 2-cup round glass storage containers with plastic lids  (1) 4-cup round glass storage container with plastic lid  (1) 2-cup measuring cup with lid
